item.text: [{"task_id":"73c3b0d8","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    particle = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    barrier = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    fall = int(round(params['motion'][0]))","    contact = int(round(params['motion'][1]))","    rise = int(round(params['motion'][2]))","    directions = [int(round(params['motion'][3])), int(round(params['motion'][4]))]","    h, w = grid.shape","    out = grid.copy()","    out[grid == particle] = background","    for point in np.argwhere(grid == particle):","        r, c = int(point[0]), int(point[1])","        r = r + fall","        if 0 <= r < h:","            out[r, c] = particle","            nextrow = r + contact","            if 0 <= nextrow < h and np.all(grid[nextrow] == barrier):","                for direction in directions:","                    for distance in range(h + w):","                        rr = r + rise * distance","                        cc = c + direction * distance","                        if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:","                            out[rr, cc] = particle","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"motion":[5]},"params":{"colors":[0,4,2],"motion":[1,1,-1,-1,1]},"rationale":"Yellow particles fall one row. A particle that then touches the red barrier emits two upward diagonal rays, forming a V; other particles simply move down."}]
